headline: Planning Commission reviews proposed Inclusionary Zoning amendment ZA-27-01 and may approve it for a Public Hearing.
summary: The Inclusionary Zoning Collaborative Working Group will review a staff-compiled proposed amendment, ZA-27-01, and decide if it is ready for the Planning Commission to approve for a Public Hearing. If not ready, the group will schedule an additional meeting.

5. Proposed Amendment ZA-27-01 Inclusionary Zoning 
  
   
Subject 5.1. Staff has compiled the proposals discussed over the last five meetings into 
a proposed amendment document. Staff will present the complete amendment 
document and open the discussion for the Working Group to provide feedback. 
If the Working Group is satisfied with the amendment document, the Planning 
Commission may approve the amendment for a Planning Commission Public 
Hearing.
